description: Spend your Sunday afternoon on the river with the Brew Crew! Join Bekki Brewer, candidate for State Representative in District 44, and Bill Ellis, Democratic nominee for Boone County Associate Circuit Judge, Division IX, at Cooper's Landing for a relaxed meet & greet and an open Q&A. We'll be joined by special guest Boone County Recorder of Deeds, Bob Nolte. Bring your questions, bring your neighbors, and come talk about the issues that matter most to working families in District 44.
